items.prompt: A model has tiny training loss and a large positive slope. What still needs checking before making a future-oriented claim?
items.modelAnswer: Check target/features and time availability, holdout performance against a baseline, residual curvature/spread/order, influential points, dependence, model assumptions, extrapolation, costs and any causal identification claim. A positive fitted slope is not trading authority.

criteria.text: Separates training fit from future validation.
Does not infer causation or action permission from association.
